content: IBus engines are D-Bus clients of ibus-daemon over a PRIVATE socket (not dbus-daemon): standard D-Bus wire protocol but ibus-daemon embeds its own mini-bus (BusDBusImpl with own Hello/NameOwnerChanged/match rules). Engines read the address from IBUS_ADDRESS env or the address file ~/.config/ibus/bus/<machine-id>-unix-wayland-0 (verified locally on IBus 1.5.29-rc2 Ubuntu 24.04; sockets live in ~/.cache/ibus/dbus-XXXX, stale sockets accumulate across daemon generations). Engine must export Factory at /org/freedesktop/IBus/Factory, engine objects implement org.freedesktop.IBus.Engine, register via RegisterComponent. Precedent Go engines (ibus-avro, ibus-bamboo) use goibus (cgo libibus bindings); pure-godbus engine has no known precedent.
